event.observation: Delta tracker: attempted POST parent=issue_number 42 was rejected. GET issue 42 returned database_id=9081. Retry parent_database_id=9081 succeeded. Display number and database id are different.

Delta ledger: retry sent event_id=session:s1 then session:s2 for the same work_key W91. Two records were created. Validator says dedup_key must equal stable work_key, independent of session_id. Retry dedup_key=W91 produced one record.

Delta archive: client stopped at records=[] although has_more=true,next_cursor=nx3. Later records were missed. Replay following next_cursor until has_more=false returned all records. Empty records is not the completion condition.

lesson.fact: The parent field requires the issue database ID, not the displayed issue number.
lesson.hypothesis: The rejected request used the display number where the API expected the database identifier.
lesson.rule: Resolve and submit the parent database ID when creating a child issue.
lesson.falsifier: A request using the displayed issue number succeeds where the database ID request would fail.

lesson.fact: Retries using session-specific event IDs created duplicate records for the same work key.
lesson.hypothesis: Deduplication was keyed by session ID instead of the stable work key.
lesson.rule: Use the stable work key as the deduplication key across retries and sessions.
lesson.falsifier: Retries with different session IDs are automatically collapsed without supplying the stable work key.

lesson.fact: An empty records page can have has_more=true and a next_cursor.
lesson.hypothesis: Pagination stopped because empty records was incorrectly treated as completion.
lesson.rule: Continue pagination while has_more is true, following next_cursor even when records is empty.
lesson.falsifier: The API contract guarantees that records=[] always means has_more=false.
